lead.headline: Metcalf goes into Paris in your flex — everyone is active
lead.deck: The lineup sits 0.6 off the projection on a coin flip that locks at 07:30. No starter is designated; nothing else to do.
lead.body: Start with your own lineup: DK Metcalf is still in the flex over Jalen Coker at the 12:50Z snapshot, 0.6 below the projection lineup, and Metcalf locks when Pittsburgh and New Orleans kick off in Paris at 07:30. It is a coin flip, so it gets no thesis either way. The Paris inactives are out and all three of yours — Warren, Metcalf, Kamara — are active, with Rico Dowdle active too, so Warren's split is what the projection already assumed. Every other starter is undesignated on the final reports: Jefferson cleared, Likely with every tight-end snap now that Theo Johnson is out, Love with no status. ESPN has you at 62% against JuiceJam. Next week Houston and the Giants are on bye; Tuesday decides the tight-end cover.
